text:
Olivia: Morning all — quick async. What I did: finished the model-serve PR (link: https://git.company/repo/pull/432), landed the small KV-cache tweak, tested canary on staging. Blockers: CI flaky on Windows runner still failing two tests, need help diagnosing a race. Today: will pair with Ben on the canary rollout plan and monitor latency dashboards.

Ben: Nice — saw the PR, left a couple of tiny comments. I can pair after lunch. For the CI flakes, I think it's the `kv_cache_test::concurrent_flush` timing. Repro with `--repeat 50` locally helps.

Rachel: Heads-up — product asked for a one-off latency spike report for yesterday (customer X saw 600ms p50). I pulled traces into the console and it looks like an autoscale cold-start region. I exported the trace links to the runbook.

Sam: Ping @Olivia — do we have a fallback model variant ready if the canary shows quality regression? I left notes in the rollout doc: https://docs.company/rollouts/canary-432.md

Olivia: Yep, we have variant v1.2-quant as immediate fallback. Rollout doc updated with switch command.

Dmitri: Quick ask — code reviewers: can someone take a look at my logging cleanup PR? https://git.company/repo/pull/438; it's small but touches runtime logging paths. No perf changes expected.

Ben: Happy to review; adding to my queue now.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary test cluster applied: redwood-canary-us-west-2. Status: rolling (3/5 nodes healthy).

Lina: Local standup note — I'm switching a couple of dashboards to include `per_token_latency` metric; should make the spike analysis easier. Also volunteering to be on-call tonight (if no objections).

Olivia: Thanks Lina, appreciate it. @Sam please add the fallback steps at top of the rollout doc, and @Dmitri I'll take your PR after Ben's pass.

Ben: Reviewed Dmitri's PR, left minor nits. Approving once tests pass.

Sam: Added fallback steps at top. Also a quick config snippet to toggle model variant in prod: ```bash curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $API" https://api.redwood.company/v1/rollout/switch -d '{"variant":"v1.2-quant"}' ```

Rachel: For the latency report, I'll attach a short blurb for the customer and include the autoscale recommendations.

Olivia: Blocker update: if anyone can spare 30m for the CI flake debugging, ping me. Otherwise I'll schedule a focused session tomorrow morning.

Ben: I can do 30m at 4pm PT.

Dmitri: I can join too.

Olivia: Great — thanks team. If nothing else, drop short status updates here so we have a record. :thumbsup:
